W.note: Restrained hairline cards with line-art products, clear size swatches, Save toggle and sold-out states, but the three-column desktop grid leaves a wide empty band on the right and the bag list sits far below the fold with no quantity controls or checkout.

X.note: The most complete shopping job (search, category chips, sort, stock warnings, quantity steppers, free-shipping bar, checkout), but gradient initial tiles, shadows, hover lift and blurbs add clutter, the mobile tiles are oversized, and the button labels and title wrapping are uneven across cards.

Y.note: Clean and well-labelled with add feedback and sold-out reasons, but the cart is a bare list below the grid with no quantity or remove controls or checkout, and cards carry noticeable dead space at the bottom.

Z.note: A tight card grid with a sticky cart beside it, quantity steppers, free-shipping progress, totals and a disabled-when-empty checkout that fits the compact brief well, though the gradient initial tiles look generic and there is no out-of-stock state.
